arguments.query: SELECT s.shipment_id, o.order_ts, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE carrier='sf' LIMIT 5
SELECT count(*), count(delivered_ts), count(DISTINCT order_id), sum(length(delivered_ts)<>length(shipped_ts)) FROM shipments WHERE carrier='sf'

SELECT count(*), sum(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts) <= 3), round(100.0*sum(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts) <= 3)/count(*),2), sum(julianday(s.delivered_ts)<julianday(s.shipped_ts)) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE s.carrier='sf' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts<>'' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01'

SELECT count(*), sum(strftime('%s',s.delivered_ts)-strftime('%s',s.shipped_ts) <= 259200), round(100.0*sum(strftime('%s',s.delivered_ts)-strftime('%s',s.shipped_ts) <= 259200)/count(*),2) FROM shipments s JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE s.carrier='sf' AND s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND s.delivered_ts<>'' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01'
